text:
Aisha (People Ops): Heads up — we've published a policy update to the employee handbook under "Data Handling & Vendor Access". Mandatory refresher training for everyone by May 15. Please complete the ~20min course in Redwood Learn: https://learn.redwood.ai/courses/data-handling

Marco (HR Ops): Contractors are included unless you have a documented exception. Managers — please confirm any exceptions by Apr 30.

Samantha (Eng Manager): How will completion be tracked? Need a team-level view to follow up.

Aisha (People Ops): Completion is automatic. We'll publish a team CSV export and a dashboard (Console -> People Ops -> Training). I'll also share a simple sheet for manual overrides for fringe cases.

Devon (SRE): Is this policy changing access to repos/keys or just clarifying handling + refresher?

Aisha (People Ops): No immediate access changes. This update clarifies expectations (credential rotation, vendor access approvals). If we change access, it'll be a separate announcement.

Marco (HR Ops): If someone can't finish by the 15th, managers can request a short extension via an HR ticket with justification.

Samantha (Eng Manager): OK, I'll ping my teams.

Liam (Contractor): I'm in a contractor org with a different onboarding flow — who handles exemptions?

Marco (HR Ops): @Liam DM me your contract ID and I'll confirm the right path.

Aisha (People Ops): Quick FAQ highlights: 1) Applies to current employees and active contractors. 2) Training counts as paid work time. 3) If someone departs during rollout we keep their completion record if completed. Full FAQ: https://intra.redwood.ai/policies/data-handling-faq

JenkinsBot: Reminder scheduled: compliance-training-due on 1769556789

Samantha (Eng Manager): :thumbsup: Can we get a list of people who haven't started yet so I can chase?

Aisha (People Ops): Weekly nudges will go out starting next week and we'll post a final report 48 hours before the deadline. I'll post an interim completion report next Wed.

Devon (SRE): Would prefer to run a short team session with the slides instead of everyone doing self-pace. Any chance we can get the slide deck + speaker notes?

Aisha (People Ops): Yes — slides + facilitator notes and a trainer booking option are available. I'll drop materials in this thread tomorrow and add a signup sheet for team sessions.

Samantha (Eng Manager): Thanks — that helps.

Aisha (People Ops): One more ask: managers, confirm by Apr 30 if anyone needs accommodations (time zone, accessibility, contractor schedule) so we can arrange alternate sessions.

Marco (HR Ops): tagging all managers to please confirm exceptions/accommodations by Apr 30. Thanks!
